^FF0000[Monster Encyclopedia]^000000
This is a Monster Encyclopedia
containing information on Water,
Wind and Ghost property monsters.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[魔物图鉴]^000000
这本魔物图鉴收录了水、风和念属性魔物的信息。

scripts.text: Water Property Monsters
scripts.translation: 水属性魔物

scripts.text: Wind Property Monsters
scripts.translation: 风属性魔物

scripts.translation: 小型魔物

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
1. Plankton
Even though they seem
insignificantly small, be careful
not to step on them. Plankton are
light and can drift on the water.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Single Cell, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
1. 漂浮虫
虽然小得不起眼，也要小心别踩到它们。
漂浮虫身体轻盈，能漂在水面上。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：单细胞、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
2. Kukre
Kukre look better than Thief Bugs
but basically loot items just the
same. Luckily, they don't attack
players in a group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Monster's Feed, Red Herb, Insect
Feeler
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
2. 库克雷
库克雷长得比浮勒盗虫好看，但一样爱捡地上的物品。
好在它们不会成群攻击玩家。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、魔物饲料、红色药草、昆虫触角

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
3. Hydra
Vegetable Monstesr that live near
water or in the deep sea that
attack using tentacles. As a group,
they're a pain in the ass.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tentacle, Sticky Mucus,
Meat.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
3. 海葵
生活在水边或深海的植物型魔物，用触手攻击。
一旦成群出现，就会非常难缠。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：触手、粘稠液体、肉

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
4. Vadon
Covered in a thick, protective
shell, Vadons attack with powerful
pincers. Although they look like
crabs, their meat can't be eaten.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Nipper, Garlet, Solid
Shell, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
4. 螃蟹
身披厚壳，以强有力的钳子攻击。
虽然看起来像螃蟹，肉却不能吃。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：钳子、加勒结晶、坚硬外皮、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
5. Marina
Transparent jellyfish that attack
by stretching their flexible bodies
in a whip-like fashion. They live
in cool places near water.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Single Cell, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
5. 水母
透明的水母，能伸展柔软的身体，像鞭子一样抽打敌人。
生活在水边凉爽的地方。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：单细胞、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
6. Cornutus
Benign monsters that conceal
themselves in hard, turban shaped
shells. They try to live as
peacefully as they can in this
crazy, crazy world.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Conch, Scell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
6. 卡那多斯
性情温和的魔物，藏身于坚硬、形似头巾的螺壳里。
它们只想在这个疯狂又疯狂的世界里，尽量过得安稳些。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：海螺、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
7. Magnolia
Cute looking creatures that appear
as large frying pans cooking an
egg. They mercilessly spank all
that oppose them.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Garlet, Scell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
7. 魔锅蛋
外形可爱，看起来像一只正在煎蛋的大平底锅。
凡是跟它们作对的，都会被毫不留情地拍打。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、加勒结晶、雪勒结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 1: Small Water Monsters]^000000
8. Marine Sphere
Strange, round-shaped monsters that
pulse with destructive energy.
Gathering their Detonators may be
useful for Alchemists.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tendon, Detonator
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第一卷：小型水属性魔物]^000000
8. 气泡虫
奇怪的球形魔物，体内涌动着破坏性的能量。
收集它们的雷管，或许对炼金术士有用。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：肌腱、雷管

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
1. Poring
Small, pink monsters that are made
of a living gelatinous substance.
They're cute, and move by
bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,
Apple, Empty Bottle, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
1. 波利
小小的粉色魔物，由有生命的凝胶状物质构成。
外形可爱，靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、苹果、空瓶、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
2. Roda Frog
Amphibious frogs that have an
annoying croak. In some countries,
their legs are a delicacy.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Webfoot, Spawn,
Green Herb, Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
2. 罗达蛙
两栖青蛙，叫声令人心烦。
在某些国家，它们的腿是一道美味。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘糊的蹼、卵、绿色药草、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
3. Spore
Mushroom-like monsters that utilise
mycelial reproduction. Usually live
in forests or dungeons.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spore, Red Herb, Blue
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
3. 魔菇
蘑菇状魔物，通过菌丝繁殖，通常生活在森林或地下城中。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：孢子、红色药草、蓝色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
4. Goblin
Small, mask wearing monsters that
viciously attack passerby's. There
seem to be different types that use
different weapons.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yellow Herb, Red
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
4. 哥布灵
戴着面具的小型魔物，会凶猛地袭击路人。
似乎分为多种类型，各自使用不同的武器。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：黄色药草、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
5. Thara Frog
Red Frogs that are much stronger
than the green Roda Frogs. They
also produce an annoying croaking
noise.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spawn, Scell, Sticky
Webfoot
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
5. 达拉蛙
红色青蛙，比绿色的罗达蛙强壮得多。
叫声同样令人心烦。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：卵、雪勒结晶、粘糊的蹼

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
6. Phen
A blue fish with a pointed nose and
sad, incredibly sad, vacant eyes.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fish Tail, Sharp Scale,
Meat, Fin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
6. 剑鱼
蓝色的鱼，鼻子尖尖的，眼神空洞又悲伤，悲伤得不得了。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鱼尾、锐利麟片、肉、鱼鳍

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
7. Marse
A miniature squid with miniature
tentacles. How it moves through
water with those tiny things is
still a scientific mystery.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Squid Ink, Tentacle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
7. 乌贼
小小的乌贼，长着小小的触手。
它们怎么靠这些细小的触手在水里移动，至今仍是科学之谜。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：墨汁、触手

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
8. Obeaune
A female Mermaid that attacks with
its wild, flowing hair. Whether or
not its male version is Merman is
still under debate.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Heart of Mermaid, Fin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
8. 人鱼
女性人鱼，以狂乱飘扬的长发攻击。
人鱼士兵究竟是不是它们的男性同类，至今仍有争议。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：人鱼之心、鱼鳍

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
9. Sohee
A female Ghost that harbours a deep
grudge. Although she is usually
crying, she can become fierce upon
encountering the living.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Black Hair, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
9. 鬼女
满怀怨恨的女性幽灵。
平时总在哭泣，遇到活人却会变得凶狠。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：长发、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
10. Marc
A proud looking Sea Horse that sort
of looks like a dragon.
Unfortunately, you can't ride it.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Gill, Fin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
10. 马克
神态高傲的海马，看起来有点像龙。
可惜不能骑。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鱼鳃、鱼鳍

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 2: Medium Water Monsters]^000000
11. Deviace
Fish monster with a big mouth
attached to a suction cup. Small,
strong, and sort of looks like a
watermelon.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Ancient Tooth, Ancient
Lips
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二卷：中型水属性魔物]^000000
11. 狄奥斯
长着吸盘状大嘴的鱼类魔物。
个头小、力气大，看起来有点像西瓜。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：人鱼之牙、人鱼嘴巴

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 3: Great Water Monsters]^000000
1. Ambernite
A snail shaped monster, it is
highly strong offense and defense.
However, it is incredibly slow like
all other snails.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snail's Shell,
Garlet, Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第三卷：大型水属性魔物]^000000
1. 蜗牛
蜗牛状魔物，攻击力和防御力都很强。
不过跟其他蜗牛一样，动作慢得惊人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜗牛壳、加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 3: Great Water Monsters]^000000
2. Sword Fish
Fish Monster with a sharp, long nose
that's just like a sword. Although it
has googly eyes, it's a dangerous
monster. Why wasn't it named Sword
Nose Fish?
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sharp Scale, Gill
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第三卷：大型水属性魔物]^000000
2. 异变鱼
长鼻子如剑般锋利的鱼类魔物。
虽然眼睛鼓鼓的、看着滑稽，却很危险。
为什么不叫它剑鼻鱼呢？
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锐利麟片、鱼鳃

scripts.translation: 小型魔物

scripts.text: Medium Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 中型魔物

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
1. Chonchon
Fly monsters that move with great
speed. Amazingly, they can heal in
the presense of fecal matter.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Fly
Wing
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
1. 苍蝇
移动速度极快的苍蝇魔物。
令人惊讶的是，只要附近有粪便，它们就能恢复生命。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、杰勒比结晶、苍蝇翅膀

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
2. Hornet
Usually benign, they will attack in
groups if one of them is harmed.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bee Sting, Jellopy,
Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
2. 蜂兵
平时性情温和，但只要有一只受到伤害，就会群起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜂刺、杰勒比结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
3. Creamy
A flying monster with beautiful
wings. It will escape by
teleporting if it thinks that it is
in grave danger.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Powder of Butterfly,
Honey, Butterfly Wing, Flower
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
3. 克瑞米
长着美丽翅膀的飞行魔物。
察觉到严重危险时，会用瞬间移动逃走。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蜂蜜、蝴蝶翅膀、花朵

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
4. Stainer
Tiny little insect with a splended,
ladybug-like shell. It can sense
magic and will attack once a spell
begins casting.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rainbow Shell, Garlet
Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
4. 瓢虫
小小的昆虫，外壳像瓢虫一样鲜艳。
能感知魔法，只要有人开始施法，就会发动攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：彩色昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
5. Steel Chonchon
Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow
and green. It picks up everything
from the ground, so be careful not
to drop items.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Garlet, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
5. 绿苍蝇
与苍蝇相似，身体却是黄绿色的。
它们会捡走地上的一切，千万别随便丢物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
6. Dustiness
This flying monsters has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
6. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物的闪避率很高，命中率低的话，最好别招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 4: Small Wind Monsters]^000000
7. Hunter Fly
Winged insect covered in the blood
of innocents. It's incredibly
quick, as well as strong. Novices
must flee from this monster at all
cost.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Solid Shell, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第四卷：小型风属性魔物]^000000
7. 赤苍蝇
浑身沾满无辜者鲜血的有翼昆虫。
速度快得惊人，实力也很强。
初心者遇到它，无论如何都要赶紧逃走。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外皮、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 5: Medium Wind Monsters]^000000
1. Condor
A bald, funny looking vulture-like
bird. They tend to attack in a
group if one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Talon, Arrow, Meat,
Feather of Birds
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第五卷：中型风属性魔物]^000000
1. 秃鹰
秃着脑袋、长相滑稽的鸟，看起来像兀鹫。
只要其中一只受到威胁，往往就会群起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：利爪、箭、肉、鸟羽

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 5: Medium Wind Monsters]^000000
2. Cobold the 1st
A monster looks like a baby wolf,
but it is smart enough to make and
use tools. Although Kobolds are
cute, they're actually quite
hostile.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Blue Hair, Zargon,
Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第五卷：中型风属性魔物]^000000
2. 刺锤犬妖
长得像小狼，却聪明得能制造和使用工具。
犬妖虽然可爱，实际上相当凶悍。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：犬妖的毛、刹勒空结晶、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 5: Medium Wind Monsters]^000000
3. Petite
A tiny, cute flying Dragon. There
is another kind of Petite that
walks, but it is of the Earth
property.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Dragon Canine, Dragon
Tail, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第五卷：中型风属性魔物]^000000
3. 毕帝特飞龙
小巧可爱的飞龙。
另有一种靠步行移动的毕帝特地龙，属于地属性。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：龙牙、龙尾、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 6: Great Wind Monsters]^000000
1. Joker
A large, enchanted playing card. If
you don't have good attack
accuracy, the stakes are against
you when fighting Joker.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: High Heels
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第六卷：大型风属性魔物]^000000
1. 裘卡
一张施了魔法的巨大扑克牌。
命中率不高的话，和裘卡交战可就胜算不大了。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：抗魔鞋

scripts.translation: 中型魔物

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 7: Small Ghost Monsters]^000000
1. Whisper
A piece of living fabric that gives
off spooky vibes. Sometimes, it
likes to turn invisible...
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fabric
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第七卷：小型念属性魔物]^000000
1. 白幽灵
一块有生命的布，散发着阴森的气息。
有时还喜欢隐形...
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：布料

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 7: Small Ghost Monsters]^000000
2. Marionette
A monster reborn as a cursed doll
that is bound to strings attached
to wooden sticks.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Golden Hair, Trunk
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第七卷：小型念属性魔物]^000000
2. 傀儡娃娃
重生为受诅咒人偶的魔物，被连在木棍上的丝线束缚着。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：金色头发、玛哪树枝

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 8: Medium Ghost Monsters]^000000
1. Eggyra
A weird, robotic egg looking thing
that waddles when it walks. No one
knows where these things come
from.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Scell, Sticky Mucus,
Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第八卷：中型念属性魔物]^000000
1. 转转蛋
奇怪的机械蛋状生物，走路摇摇摆摆。
没人知道它们从哪儿来。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：雪勒结晶、粘稠液体、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 9: Great Ghost Monsters]^000000
1. Nightmare
A ghostly horse that radiates a
violet aura of evil.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horseshoe, Blue Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第九卷：大型念属性魔物]^000000
1. 梦魇
幽灵般的马，周身散发着邪恶的紫色光晕。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：马蹄铁、蓝色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 9: Great Ghost Monsters]^000000
2. Medusa
Monster with hair composed of
snakes. It is rumoured to turn
people into stone if they look into
her eyes.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Medusa Head, Horrendous
Hair, White Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第九卷：大型念属性魔物]^000000
2. 米杜沙
以蛇为发的魔物。
传说只要直视她的眼睛，就会变成石头。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：米杜沙的头、蛇发、白色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Monster Encyclopedia]^000000
This is a Monster Encyclopedia
containing information on Earth,
Fire and Neutral property
monsters.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[魔物图鉴]^000000
这本魔物图鉴收录了地、火和无属性魔物的信息。

scripts.text: Earth Property Monsters
scripts.translation: 地属性魔物

scripts.text: Fire Property Monsters
scripts.translation: 火属性魔物

scripts.text: Neutral Property Monsters
scripts.translation: 无属性魔物

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Small Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 小型魔物

scripts.text: Medium Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 中型魔物

scripts.text: Great Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 大型魔物

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
1. Fabre
The weak and small larva of Creamy.
Although some say it is cute, the
author must disagree.
Whole-heartedly.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Feather, Fluff, Green
Herb, Clover
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
1. 绿棉虫
克瑞米的幼虫，弱小又不起眼。
虽然有人说它可爱，作者却坚决不同意。
绝对不同意。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：羽毛、绒毛、绿色药草、三叶草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
2. Pupa
Monster that is the pupal stage of
Fabre. It doesn't attack at all, so
it's easy to kill for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
2. 虫蛹
绿棉虫化蛹后的魔物。
完全不会攻击，初心者也很容易将其击杀。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
3. Martin
An adorable mole wearing a safety
helmet. He's deathly afraid of
cave-ins and occasionally stops to
cower in fear.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mole Whiskers, Mole
Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
3. 土拨鼠
戴着安全帽的可爱土拨鼠。
它怕极了塌方，有时会停下来，吓得缩成一团。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠须、鼠指甲

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
4. Savage Bebe
Tiny, pink baby Savage. It's
disheartening to know that it grows
up to become ugly-looking.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Animal Skin, Meat,
Arrow, Feather
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
4. 小野猪
小小的粉色野猪宝宝。
一想到它长大后会变得那么丑，真让人泄气。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：动物外皮、肉、箭、羽毛

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
5. Andre
A kind of worker ant, Andres are
yellow, very diligent and gather
everything in sight for the Queen
Ant.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
5. 白蚁
黄色的工蚁，非常勤劳，会把眼前的一切都收集起来献给蚁后。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
6. Coco
A small Squirrel with dark
piercing eyes. It's always holding
an Acorn, and would be cute if it
didn't always have a look of utter
contempt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Acorn, Fluff, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
6. 松鼠
小松鼠，眼睛乌黑，目光锐利，怀里总抱着一颗橡果。
要不是总摆出一副极度轻蔑的表情，倒也挺可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：橡果、绒毛、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
7. Piere
Pieres are green worker ants that
are subtly different than Andres.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
7. 工蚁
绿色的工蚁，与白蚁略有不同。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
8. Smokie
A chubby little raccoon that loves
nothing better than to scamper.
It's rumored to use a magic leaf to
become invisible!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Raccoon Leaf, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
8. 狸猫
胖乎乎的小浣熊，最喜欢到处乱跑。
传说能用一片魔法叶子隐形！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：变身叶子、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
9. Deniro
Red worker ants that live to serve
the Queen Ant. If there's anything
on the ground, they'll pick it up.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
9. 兵蚁
红色的工蚁，一生都为蚁后效劳。
地上有什么，就捡什么。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
10. Yoyo
A naughty monkey that picks up
anything from the ground. They're
very quick and will gang up on you
if you attack just one of them.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yoyo Tail, Banana,
Yellow Herb, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
10. 溜溜猴
调皮的猴子，地上的东西什么都捡。
动作很快，只要攻击其中一只，就会遭到它们的围攻。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：溜溜猴尾巴、香蕉、黄色药草、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
11. Vitata
Plump worker ants that heal the
other ants in their colony. When
killed their bodies leak... honey?
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Scell,
Honey
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
11. 黑蚁
胖乎乎的工蚁，会为蚁群中的同伴治疗。
被杀死后，体内竟然会流出...蜂蜜？
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、雪勒结晶、蜂蜜

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
12. Caramel
An adorable porcupine with tiny
spiky quills. However, it gets
incredibly angry when touched.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Porcupine Quill,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
12. 刺猬虫
可爱的豪猪，长着细小的尖刺。
不过，一碰它就会大发雷霆。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：刺猬尖刺、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 10: Small Earth Monsters]^000000
13. Giearth
An elderly pixie that wanders caves
to gather ores. They're incredible
chain smokers.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Old Pixie's Moustache
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十卷：小型地属性魔物]^000000
13. 基尔瑟
在洞穴里四处采集矿石的老妖精。
烟瘾大得惊人，一根接一根地抽。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：老妖精胡须

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
1. Willow
Creature reborn from an old tree.
Its features and the sounds it
makes are incredibly eerie.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tree Root, Trunk, Red
Herb, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
1. 树精
由老树重生的生物。
模样和叫声都诡异得令人毛骨悚然。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：树根、玛哪树枝、红色药草、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
2. Rocker
A lazy grasshopper that loves to
play the violin, just like in
Aesop's fable.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Grasshopper's Leg,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
2. 蝗虫
懒洋洋的蚱蜢，喜欢拉小提琴，就像伊索寓言里的一样。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝗虫后腿、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
3. Mandragora
Although it stays in the same
place, it can attack passerby from
a distance using underground
stalks.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Stem, Green Herb,
Shoot
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
3. 曼陀罗魔花
虽然不会移动，却能用地下的茎攻击远处的路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：茎、绿色药草、嫩芽

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
4. Wolf
Wild, roving wolves with blue
manes. They tend to attack as a
pack when even one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Wolf Claw, Meat,
Monster's Feed, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
4. 狼
长着蓝色鬃毛、四处游荡的野狼。
只要其中一只受到威胁，往往就会群起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：狼指甲、肉、魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
5. Snake
Green snake that lives in the
forests and deserts. They're not
poisonous, but their bites still
hurt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snake Scale, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
5. 蛇
生活在森林和沙漠中的绿蛇。
虽然无毒，被咬一口还是很疼。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛇鳞、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
6. Horn
Although it looks fierce, it's
actually a peaceful insect. It
roams around fields with a
crunching sound.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horn, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
6. 锹形虫
模样凶猛，实际却很温和的昆虫。
在田野间游走时，会发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锹形虫角、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
7. Orc Warrior
A warrior of the proud race of
Orcs. At one time, Orcs and humans
were allies, but now they are
bitter enemies.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Orcish Voucher
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
7. 兽人战士
骄傲的兽人族战士。
兽人与人类曾是盟友，如今却成了死敌。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：兽人战士之证

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
8. Hode
A huge earthworm that usually hides
under the ground. It can usually be
found in the desert.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Earthworm Peeling,
Sticky Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
8. 蚯蚓
巨大的蚯蚓，平时藏在地下，多见于沙漠。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蚯蚓皮、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
9. Mantis
It wanders about fields, waving a
tiny fan. An entire martial arts
style is based on the movements of
this insect.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mantis Scythe, Scell
Solid Shell, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
9. 螳螂
挥着小扇子，在田野间游荡。
有一整个武术流派，就是模仿这种昆虫的动作创立的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：螳螂臂、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
10. Savage
A wild boar that walks around,
grunting restlessly. Its rough
looking tusks make it hard to
believe it was cute as a baby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mane, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
10. 野猪
四处走动的野猪，总是不安地哼哼。
看着那凶悍的獠牙，很难相信它小时候竟然那么可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鬃毛、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 11: Medium Earth Monsters]^000000
11. Petite
Cute, walking Dragon. There is
another kind of Petite that flys,
but it is of the Wind property.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Dragon Canine, Dragon
Tail, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十一卷：中型地属性魔物]^000000
11. 毕帝特地龙
靠步行移动的可爱小龙。
另有一种会飞的毕帝特飞龙，属于风属性。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：龙牙、龙尾、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 12: Great Earth Monsters]^000000
1. Worm Tail
A strange monster that uses
whiping attacks with a tail that
looks like a blade of grass.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Pointed Scale, Yellow
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十二卷：大型地属性魔物]^000000
1. 尾虫
奇怪的魔物，用形似草叶的尾巴鞭打敌人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鳞片梗、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 12: Great Earth Monsters]^000000
2. Muka
Cute Cactus commonly found in the
desert. It tries to threaten
passerby with its growls, but its
noises are too funny to be scary.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cactus Needle, Empty
Bottle, Green Herb, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十二卷：大型地属性魔物]^000000
2. 摩卡
沙漠中常见的可爱仙人掌。
试图用吼声吓唬路人，可声音实在太滑稽，根本吓不到谁。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：仙人掌刺、空瓶、绿色药草、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 12: Great Earth Monsters]^000000
3. Bigfoot
Although its name may be
misleading, Bigfoot is actually a
large bera. It walks like it owns
the forest, and it does.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bear's Foot Skin,
Animal Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十二卷：大型地属性魔物]^000000
3. 大脚熊
名字虽容易让人误会，其实是一头大熊。
走起路来就像森林的主人——而它确实是。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：熊脚皮、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 12: Great Earth Monsters]^000000
4. Flora
A man-eating plant. Its parts are
considered useful for Alchemists to
make monsters of their own...
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Maneater Blossom, Stem
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十二卷：大型地属性魔物]^000000
4. 噬人花
吃人的植物。
据说它身上的材料能帮炼金术士制造自己的魔物...
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：噬人树花、茎

scripts.text: Small Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 小型魔物

scripts.text: Medium Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 中型魔物

scripts.text: Great Sized Monsters
scripts.translation: 大型魔物

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 13: Small Fire Monsters]^000000
1. Picky
Cute little chick that may grow up
to be a Peco Peco, unless, of
course, you kill it.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Feather of Birds,
Feather, Red Herb, Milk
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十三卷：小型火属性魔物]^000000
1. 小鸡
可爱的小鸡，或许能长成大嘴鸟。
当然，前提是你没把它杀了。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鸟羽、羽毛、红色药草、牛奶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 13: Small Fire Monsters]^000000
2. Baby Desert Wolf
A Baby Desert Wolf that tires to
threaten adventurers with its cute,
little yelps.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Animal Skin, Meat
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十三卷：小型火属性魔物]^000000
2. 沙漠幼狼
试图用小小的、可爱的叫声吓唬冒险者的沙漠幼狼。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：动物外皮、肉

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 13: Small Fire Monsters]^000000
3. Horong,
An eerie-looking, violent fireball.
It's useless to use hiding skills
near this vengeful spirit.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Stone Heart, Zargon,
Fire Arrow
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十三卷：小型火属性魔物]^000000
3. 鬼火
模样诡异、性情凶暴的火球。
在这怨灵附近使用隐匿技能，可没有用。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：石心、刹勒空结晶、火箭矢

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
1. Drops
The desert version of the Poring
that has a pale orange colour. It
seems a tiny bit stronger than
Poring, though.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,
Apple, Empty Bottle, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
1. 土波利
生活在沙漠中的波利，呈淡橙色。
不过，似乎比波利强那么一点点。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、苹果、空瓶、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
2. Elder Willow
The elderly version of the Willow
monster. It's red and can even use
some magic.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Resin, Trunk, Sweet
Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
2. 长老树精
年老的树精，身体呈红色，甚至会用一些魔法。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：树脂、玛哪树枝、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
3. Metaller
The evolved form of Rocker. It is
dim brown and lives in the desert.
This cricket will pick items up
from the ground.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Red Blood,
Grasshopper's Leg, Scell, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
3. 重金属蝗虫
蝗虫的进化形态，身体呈暗棕色，生活在沙漠里。
这种蟋蟀会捡地上的物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：火灵矿石、蝗虫后腿、雪勒结晶、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
4. Zerom
An undead slave. Sadly, not even
death will bring peace to the
abusive hours of labor Zerom
suffers from his Pharaoh.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Panties
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
4. 杰洛米
不死的奴隶。
可悲的是，就连死亡也无法让它摆脱法老王强加的繁重劳役。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：内裤

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
5. Scorpion
Scorpions can be found in areas
where there is desert. It has a
beautiful colour, but can be
dangerous.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Scorpion Tail, Green
Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
5. 蝎子
常见于沙漠的蝎子。
颜色虽然漂亮，却可能很危险。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝎子尾巴、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
6. Desert Wolf
Wolves in the desert are much
stronger than those living in the
forset. If you strike one, you'll
have to deal with the whole pack.
Item Drops; Animal Skin, Mink
Coat, Meat, Wolf Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
6. 沙漠之狼
沙漠里的狼比森林里的强壮得多。
只要攻击其中一只，就得面对整个狼群。
掉落物品：动物外皮、毛皮大衣、肉、狼指甲

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
7. Frilldora
Lizard with a frilly, fan-like
neck. Although it looks rediculous,
it's actually pretty strong.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Frill, Reptile Tongue,
Red Herb, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
7. 伞蜥
颈部有扇状褶边的蜥蜴。
虽然模样滑稽，实力却相当强。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：褶边、爬虫类舌头、红色药草、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
8. Cobold the 3rd
A blue, wolf-like monster that is
amazingly cuddly. However, all
Kobolds have sworn to hate humans.
There are different kinds of
Kobolds that use different
weapons.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Blue Hair, Zargon,
Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
8. 犬妖第三型
蓝色的狼形魔物，可爱得让人想抱抱。
不过，所有犬妖都发誓憎恨人类。
犬妖有不同种类，使用的武器也各不相同。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：犬妖的毛、刹勒空结晶、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 14: Medium Fire Monsters]^000000
9. Jakk
A spooky, Pumpkin-headed monster
that dresses in a slick formal
suit. It's been known to invade
Prontera on St. Hallow's Eve in the
past.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jack'o'Pumpkin, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十四卷：中型火属性魔物]^000000
9. 南瓜先生
长着南瓜头、穿着利落礼服的诡异魔物。
过去曾在万圣节前夕入侵普隆德拉。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：南瓜头、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 15: Great Fire Monsters]^000000
1. Peco Peco
Nowadays peco peco is popular as a
vehicle for Knights and Crusaders.
They live in the Desert or Forest
and will also attack in packs if
one of them is threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bill of Birds, Yellow
Herb, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十五卷：大型火属性魔物]^000000
1. 大嘴鸟
如今深受骑士和十字军喜爱的坐骑。
生活在沙漠或森林中，只要有一只受到威胁，也会群起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鸟嘴、黄色药草、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 15: Great Fire Monsters]^000000
2. Marduk
A gangly wizard of darkness. Look
out, it knows magic!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Flame Heart
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十五卷：大型火属性魔物]^000000
2. 马尔杜克
瘦高的黑暗巫师。
小心，它会魔法！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：火灵原石

scripts.translation: 小型魔物

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 16: Small Neutral Monsters]^000000
1. Lunatic
A shaggy monster that looks kind of
like a rabbit. Although some may
think it's cute, the author
believes it to be absolutely
hideous. Perhaps that is because of
his alleriges.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Clover, Feather,
Carrot, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十六卷：小型无属性魔物]^000000
1. 疯兔
毛茸茸的魔物，看起来有点像兔子。
虽然有人觉得可爱，作者却认为它丑得不得了。
也许是因为作者会过敏。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：三叶草、羽毛、胡萝卜、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 16: Small Neutral Monsters]^000000
2. Peco Peco Egg
The egg of a Peco Peco. It's small,
and defenseless, making it a
perfect target for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Red Herb,
Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十六卷：小型无属性魔物]^000000
2. 大嘴鸟蛋
大嘴鸟的蛋，小小的，毫无抵抗能力，是初心者的理想目标。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、红色药草、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 16: Small Neutral Monsters]^000000
3. Ant Egg
An Ant Egg that is also
defenseless. Some of them actually
hatch, though.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Sticky
Mucus, Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十六卷：小型无属性魔物]^000000
3. 蚂蚁卵
同样毫无抵抗能力的蚂蚁卵，不过有些真的会孵化。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 16: Small Neutral Monsters]^000000
4. Baby Thief Bug
Dirty, filthy Creatures that tend
to work in groups. Whatever you do,
don't let them pollute the Prontera
Culvert, it'd be a disaster!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Red Herb,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十六卷：小型无属性魔物]^000000
4. 幼体浮勒盗虫
肮脏污秽的生物，喜欢成群行动。
无论如何都别让它们污染普隆德拉下水道，否则就糟了！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、红色药草、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 17: Medium Neutral Monsters]^000000
^0099FF...^000000

^0099FFSome pages seem to have been ripped^000000
^0099FFout of this book, and replaced with^000000
^0099FFpinups of the Isis monster. It^000000
^0099FFlooks like you'll need to learn^000000
^0099FFabout Neutral, medium sizd^000000
^0099FFmonsters on your own.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0099FF这本书似乎有几页^000000^0099FF被撕掉了，取而代之的是^000000^0099FF蛇女伊丝的写真。^000000
^0099FF看来你得自行了解^000000^0099FF无属性的中型^000000^0099FF魔物了。^000000

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 18: Great Neutral Monsters]^000000
1. Golem
A being of living stone that has
been enchanted with black magic. It
can recognise spell casting, but
moves incredibly slowly due to its
weight problem.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Scell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十八卷：大型无属性魔物]^000000
1. 巨石怪
被黑魔法赋予生命的石头生物。
能察觉施法，但体重实在太大，移动慢得惊人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：雪勒结晶

This is a Monster Encyclopedia
containing information on Dark,
Poison and Undead monsters.
scripts.translation:

这本魔物图鉴收录了暗、毒和不死属性魔物的信息。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
1. Thief Bug Egg
A filthy egg from a filthy Thief
Bug. They make horrible omelets.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
1. 盗虫卵
肮脏的浮勒盗虫产下的肮脏虫卵。
拿来做煎蛋，难吃得要命。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
2. Familiar
A gray bat that's not very strong,
but really annoying because it
attacks very fast and relentlessly
pursues passerby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tooth of Bat, Fly Wing,
Grape, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
2. 吸血蝙蝠
灰色蝙蝠，实力不强，却十分烦人。
攻击速度很快，还会死追着路人不放。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝙蝠牙、苍蝇翅膀、葡萄、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
3. Tarou
A tiny, little white mouse. Its
squeaks can be heard in the Dead
Pit and the Prontera Culvert.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rat Tail, Animal
Skin, Feather, Monster's Feed
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
3. 白鼠
小小的白老鼠。
在废弃矿场和普隆德拉下水道，都能听见它们的吱吱声。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠尾、动物外皮、羽毛、魔物饲料

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
4. Drainliar
A blood red bat that's much
stronger than Familiar. It also
tends to pursue any human it
finds.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tooth of Bat, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
4. 红蝙蝠
血红色的蝙蝠，比吸血蝙蝠强得多。
发现人类，往往就会追上去。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝙蝠牙、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
5. Dokkaebi
A traditional Korean demon with the
power to generate wealth. Using
Mammonite is no big deal to them.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Dokkaebi Horn
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
5. 土人魔
韩国传统传说中的鬼怪，拥有生财的能力。
使用金钱攻击，对它们来说根本不算什么。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：土人魔角

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 19: Small Dark Monsters]^000000
6. Deviruchi
A miniature demon that repeatedly
stabs umans with its pitchfork.
It's cute, but nonetheless a true
fiend of darkness.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Little Evil Horn,
Little Evil Wing, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第十九卷：小型暗属性魔物]^000000
6. 小恶魔
小小的恶魔，会用草叉反复刺向人类。
虽然可爱，却仍是真正的黑暗恶魔。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：小恶魔角、小恶魔翅膀、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
1. Female Thief Bug
Large, brown insects that are
gruesome to the eye and disgusting
to the touch. Notorious for quickly
grabbing whatever drops to the
ground.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Red Herb,
Jellopy, Garlet, Insect Feeler
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
1. 雌性浮勒盗虫
大型棕色昆虫，看着吓人，摸着恶心。
以迅速抢走掉在地上的物品而臭名昭著。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、红色药草、杰勒比结晶、加勒结晶、昆虫触角

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
2. Male Thief Bug
A large, green insect, the Male
Thief Bug is considerably powerful.
They're also very aggressive
towards humans.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Red Herb,
Jellopy, Garlet, Insect Feeler,
Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
2. 雄性浮勒盗虫
大型绿色昆虫，实力相当强。
对人类也极具攻击性。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、红色药草、杰勒比结晶、加勒结晶、昆虫触角、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
3. Matyr
A hound saturated with evil. It's
always sleeping, but springs to
action after smelling an
adventurer.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Monster's Feed,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
3. 黑狐
充满邪气的猎犬，平时总在睡觉。
一闻到冒险者的气味，就会立刻扑起来。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
4. Zenorc
A dishonourable Orc whose body has
been cursed. They continue their
shameful ways by looting items that
have been dropped to the ground.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Zenorc's Fang, Sticky
Mucus, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
4. 兹诺克
不知廉耻、身体受到诅咒的兽人。
仍在干着可耻的勾当，抢走掉在地上的物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：兹诺克之牙、粘稠液体、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
5. Requiem
An ancient slave that carries a
heavy coffin on its back. Weary
from its labour, Requiem simply
collapses, hoping the coffing will
hit its mark, when attacking
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Old Blue Box
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
5. 诺可伊
背着沉重棺材的古代奴隶。
劳累不堪的它攻击时干脆倒下，只盼棺材能砸中目标。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：神秘箱子

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 20: Medium Dark Monsters]^000000
6. Bathory
A wart-nosed Witch wearing bunny
boxers that will attack anything
prettier that her. In other words,
she attacks everyone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Witch Starsand
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十卷：中型暗属性魔物]^000000
6. 巫婆
鼻子上长着疣、穿着兔子图案内裤的女巫，会攻击所有比她漂亮的家伙。
换句话说，她谁都打。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：魔女之星沙

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 21: Great Dark Monsters]^000000
1. Isis
A monster that is half serpent and
half woman, as well as one of
Osiris' trusted champions.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Scale Skin, Shining
Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十一卷：大型暗属性魔物]^000000
1. 蛇女伊丝
半蛇半人的魔物，也是俄塞里斯信赖的勇士之一。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鳞片皮、发亮鳞片

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 21: Great Dark Monsters]^000000
2. Raydric
The soul of a castle guard bound to
a living suit of armour through a
curse.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Elunium, Chivalry
Emblem
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十一卷：大型暗属性魔物]^000000
2. 幽灵剑士
城堡卫兵的灵魂，被诅咒束缚在一副会动的铠甲中。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：铝、忠诚之证

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 22: Small Poison Monsters]^000000
^0099FF...^000000

^0099FFThere are^000000
^0099FFPoring stickers^000000
^0099FFall over these pages!^000000

^0099FFIt looks like you'll have to learn^000000
^0099FFabout small, poisonous monsters all^000000
^0099FFon your own.^000000

^FF0000[Vol. 23: Medium Posion Monsters]^000000
1. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Poison property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus, Garlet,
Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十三卷：中型毒属性魔物]^000000
1. 波波利
浅绿色、毒属性的波利，比波利强得多，却仍然靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 23: Medium Posion Monsters]^000000
2. Poison Spore
A black capped mushroom. It attacks
adventurers in fear of being eaten,
despite being poisonous and not
delicious.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spore, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十三卷：中型毒属性魔物]^000000
2. 毒魔菇
长着黑色菌盖的蘑菇。
明明有毒又不好吃，却还是怕被吃掉，因此会攻击冒险者。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：孢子、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 23: Medium Posion Monsters]^000000
3. Cobold the 2nd
A small, wolf-like monster that's
intelligent enough to use weapons.
Look out, though, he's pretty mean
for a little guy.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Blue Hair, Zargon,
Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十三卷：中型毒属性魔物]^000000
3. 犬妖第二型
小小的狼形魔物，聪明得会使用武器。
可要小心，别看个头小，脾气却很坏。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：犬妖的毛、刹勒空结晶、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 23: Medium Posion Monsters]^000000
4. Side Winder
A dark coloured snake that hates
people. Be careful, and kill them
before they can poison you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shining Scale, Zargon,
Poisonous Canine, Snake Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十三卷：中型毒属性魔物]^000000
4. 黑蛇
讨厌人类的深色蛇。
小心，最好在它让你中毒之前解决它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：发亮鳞片、刹勒空结晶、毒牙、蛇鳞

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 24: Great Poison Monsters]^000000
1. Argos
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十四卷：大型毒属性魔物]^000000
1. 艾斯蜘蛛
见到冒险者就会攻击的巨大蜘蛛。
块头太大，冒险者可没法一脚踩扁它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 24: Great Poison Monsters]^000000
2. Argriope
A segmented, millipede type monster
that will attack passerby with
poison.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bug Leg, Zargon, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十四卷：大型毒属性魔物]^000000
2. 艾吉欧蜈蚣
身体分节的千足虫型魔物，会用毒攻击路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫后脚、刹勒空结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 24: Great Poison Monsters]^000000
3. Myst
A strange, monster made of mist
that is attached to a phantom
window.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Trunk, Gas Mask
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十四卷：大型毒属性魔物]^000000
3. 麦斯特
由雾气组成、附着在幽灵窗户上的奇怪魔物。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：玛哪树枝、防毒面具

^0099FFon your very own.^000000

^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
1. Zombie
An innocent human that has been
raised from the dead through black
magic.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Decayed Nail, Sticky
Mucus, Horrendous Mouth
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
1. 腐尸
无辜的人类，被黑魔法从死者中唤醒。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：亡者指甲、粘稠液体、亡者牙齿

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
2. Megalodon
An animated fish skeleton that
roams the seas. Although it looks
scary, it's actually benign.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Stinky Scale,
Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
2. 邪骸食人鱼
获得生命、在海中游荡的鱼骨架。
虽然看着吓人，实际上却很温和。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：腐烂鳞片、骷髅骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
3. Orc Zombie
Orcs that have risen back from the
dead. The honourable fighting spirit
of the Orc Warrior never dies!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Orc Claw, Sticky Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
3. 兽人腐尸
死而复生的兽人。
兽人战士光荣的斗志永不消亡！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：兽人指甲、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
4. Pirate Skel
A topless pirate skeleton that
skips around in purple socks.
Scourge of the seven seas.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
4. 邪骸海盗
赤着上身、穿着紫色袜子四处蹦跳的海盗骷髅。
七海的祸害。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：骷髅骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
5. Orc Skeleton
The skeleton of an Orc that has
been brought back to life. Even in
death, Orcs continue to do battle.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Orc's Fang, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
5. 邪骸兽人
重获生命的兽人骨架。
即使死了，兽人也仍在战斗。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：兽人犬齿、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
6. Soldier Skeleton
A skeleton soldier that wields two
swords at once. He must have been a
badass when he was alive.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
6. 邪骸士兵
同时挥舞双剑的骷髅士兵。
活着的时候，肯定是个狠角色。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：骷髅骨、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
7. Munak
A beautiful zombie that seems to be
linked to Bongun somehow.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Daenggie, Munak Turban
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
7. 僵尸
美丽的僵尸，似乎与妖道有某种联系。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：辫子、僵尸头巾

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
8. Skel Worker
A reanimated skeleton of a miner
that has died without receiving its
severance pay.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Iron, Lantern
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
8. 邪骸矿工
死时还没拿到遣散费、后来又被复活的矿工骷髅。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：铁、灯笼

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
9. Archer Skeleton
Despite not having actual eyes,
Archer Skeletons have great aim.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone, Fire Arrow,
Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
9. 邪骸弓箭手
明明没有眼睛，射击却准得很。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：骷髅骨、火箭矢、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
10. Mummy
A walking corpse covered with
bandages. It probably used to be
beautiful once.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rotten Bandage
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
10. 木乃伊
裹着绷带行走的尸体。
生前或许也曾很美。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：腐烂绷带

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
11. Verit
A mummified dog that will pick up
anything dropped to the ground.
Although it's a zombie, it seems
happy to be alive again.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Immortal Heart, Zargon
Rotten Bandage
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
11. 毕莱特
木乃伊化的狗，地上掉什么就捡什么。
虽然是行尸，却似乎很高兴能再次活过来。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：不死心脏、刹勒空结晶、腐烂绷带

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 26: Medium Undead Monsters]^000000
12. Ghoul
Similar to a Zombie, but Ghouls are
green and much stronger. Its
retching is offensive in more ways
than one.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horrendous Mouth
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十六卷：中型不死属性魔物]^000000
12. 绿腐尸
与腐尸相似，却是绿色的，也强壮得多。
它的呕吐不光恶心，还能伤人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：亡者牙齿

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vol. 27: Great Undead Monsters]^000000
1. Evil Druid
A flamboyantly evil druid. It's
always using a floating spellbook
that crackles with energy to cause
misery to adventurers
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Amulet, White Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[第二十七卷：大型不死属性魔物]^000000
1. 暗神官
邪恶得十分张扬的德鲁伊。
总用一本悬浮着、能量噼啪作响的魔法书折磨冒险者。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：护身符、白色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
1. Ant Egg
Merely an Ant Egg. It can't hurt
you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Sticky
Mucus, Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
1. 蚂蚁卵
只是蚂蚁卵而已，伤不了你。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
2. Andre
A diligent worker ant that lives
for the sake of the colony. Look
out though, hit one and you'll
fight them all.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
2. 白蚁
勤劳的工蚁，一心为蚁群效劳。
不过要小心，打了一只，就得跟整群战斗。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
3. Piere
A green worker ant that works just
as diligently as Andre.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm
Peeling, Garlet, Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
3. 工蚁
绿色的工蚁，和白蚁一样勤劳。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
4. Deniro
The red worker ant, and is
faster than Pieres and Deniros.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
4. 兵蚁
红色的工蚁，比工蚁和兵蚁跑得更快。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
5. Vitata
Worker ants that are plump with
honey... So plump, they won't pick
up anything.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Scell
Honey
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
5. 黑蚁
肚子里装满蜂蜜的工蚁...
胖得连地上的东西都不捡了。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、雪勒结晶、蜂蜜

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 1F Monsters]^000000
6. Giearth
An elderly pixie that wanders caves
to gather ores. When he dies, he
plans to leave the world his
beautiful moustache.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Old Pixie's Moustache
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱1楼魔物]^000000
6. 基尔瑟
在洞穴里四处采集矿石的老妖精。
打算死后把漂亮的胡须留给世人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：老妖精胡须

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
1. Ant Egg
Ant eggs incapable of attacking, or
even feeling pain.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Sticky
Mucus, Empty Bottle
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
1. 蚂蚁卵
不会攻击，甚至感觉不到疼痛的蚂蚁卵。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、空瓶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
2. Andre
A yellow worker ant that may be the
slowest of its race, aside from
Vitata.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
2. 白蚁
黄色的工蚁，除了黑蚁，可能就数它们最慢。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
3. Piere
A green worker and obviously
hailing from France.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
3. 工蚁
绿色的工蚁，显然来自法国。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
4. Deniro
The speediest of the worker ants
that comes in a flashy red colour.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Sticky Mucus, Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
4. 兵蚁
跑得最快的工蚁，身体鲜红夺目。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、粘稠液体、坚硬外壳

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
5. Vitata
Worker ants in charge of storing
honey inside their bellies.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Scell,
Honey
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
5. 黑蚁
负责把蜂蜜存进肚子里的工蚁。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫外壳、雪勒结晶、蜂蜜

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
6. Giearth
An elderly pixie that wanders caves
to gather ores. Almost a dwarf, but
not quite.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Old Pixie's Moustache
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
6. 基尔瑟
在洞穴里四处采集矿石的老妖精。
几乎算是矮人，却又不完全是。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：老妖精胡须

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ant Hell 2F Monsters]^000000
7. Phreeoni
An extremely strong bastard that is
forty percent tongue.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tongue, Ant Jaw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[蚂蚁地狱2楼魔物]^000000
7. 皮里恩
强得离谱的混蛋，身体有百分之四十都是舌头。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：舌头、蚂蚁下巴

^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 1F Monsters]^000000
1. Familiar
A gray bat that's not very strong,
but really annoying because it
attacks very fast and relentlessly
pursues passerby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tooth of Bat, Fly Wing,
Grape, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城1楼魔物]^000000
1. 吸血蝙蝠
灰色蝙蝠，实力不强，却十分烦人。
攻击速度很快，还会死追着路人不放。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝙蝠牙、苍蝇翅膀、葡萄、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 1F Monsters]^000000
2. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Poison property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus, Garlet
Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城1楼魔物]^000000
2. 波波利
浅绿色、毒属性的波利，比波利强得多，却仍然靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 1F Monsters]^000000
3. Dustiness
This flying monster has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing,
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城1楼魔物]^000000
3. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物的闪避率很高，命中率低的话，最好别招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 1F Monsters]^000000
4. Poison Spore
A black capped mushroom. It attacks
adventurers in fear of being eaten,
despite being poisonous and not
delicious.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spore, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城1楼魔物]^000000
4. 毒魔菇
长着黑色菌盖的蘑菇。
明明有毒又不好吃，却还是怕被吃掉，因此会攻击冒险者。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：孢子、绿色药草

^0099FF掉落物品^000000：孢子、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 2F Monsters]^000000
4. Argos
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城2楼魔物]^000000
4. 艾斯蜘蛛
见到冒险者就会攻击的巨大蜘蛛。
块头太大，冒险者可没法一脚踩扁它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 2F Monsters]^000000
5. Whisper
A piece of living fabric that gives
off spooky vibes. Sometimes, it
likes to turn invisible...
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fabric
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城2楼魔物]^000000
5. 白幽灵
一块有生命的布，散发着阴森的气息。
有时还喜欢隐形...
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：布料

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Geffen Dungeon 2F Monsters]^000000
6. Jakk
A spooky, Pumpkin-headed monster
that dresses in a slick formal
suit. It's been known to invade
Prontera on St. Hallow's Even in the
past.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jack'o'Pumpkin, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[吉芬地下城2楼魔物]^000000
6. 南瓜先生
长着南瓜头、穿着利落礼服的诡异魔物。
过去曾在万圣节前夕入侵普隆德拉。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：南瓜头、刹勒空结晶

一旦成群出现，就会非常难缠。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：触手、粘稠液体、肉

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
3. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Poison property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
3. 波波利
浅绿色、毒属性的波利，比波利强得多，却仍然靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
4. Thara Frog
Red Frogs that are much stronger
than the green Roda Frogs. They
also produce an annoying croaking
noise.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spawn, Scell, Sticky
Webfoot
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
4. 达拉蛙
红色的青蛙，比绿色的罗达蛙强得多。
还会发出烦人的呱呱声。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：卵、雪勒结晶、粘糊的蹼

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
5. Whisper
A piece of living fabric that gives
off spooky vibes. Sometimes, it
likes to turn invisible...
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fabric
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
5. 白幽灵
一块有生命的布，散发着阴森的气息。
有时还喜欢隐形...
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：布料

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
6. Megalodon
Skeleton Fish having spooky empty
eye-holes.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Stinky Scale, Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
6. 邪骸食人鱼
只有骨架的鱼，空洞的眼窝令人毛骨悚然。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：腐烂鳞片、骷髅骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
7. Pirate Skel
A topless pirate skeleton that
skips around in purple socks.
Scourge of the seven seas.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
7. 邪骸海盗
赤裸着上身、穿着紫色袜子，蹦蹦跳跳的骷髅海盗。
七海的祸害。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：骷髅骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
8. Marionette
A monster reborn as a cursed doll
that is bound to strings attached
to wooden sticks.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Golden Hair, Trunk
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
8. 傀儡娃娃
以受诅咒的玩偶之身重生的魔物，身上缠着连在木棍上的提线。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：金色头发、玛哪树枝

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
9. Drake
A peg-legged, ghostly pirate
captain that takes its leisurely
time to attack the living.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone, White
Herb, Elunium
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船2楼魔物]^000000
9. 海盗之王
装着木制假腿的幽灵海盗船长，总是慢悠悠地攻击活人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：骷髅骨、白色药草、铝

scripts.text: 1F
scripts.translation: 1楼

scripts.text: 3F
scripts.translation: 3楼

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
1. Poring
Small, pink monsters that are made
of a living gelatinous substance.
They're cute, and move by
bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,
Apple, Empty Bottle, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
1. 波利
由有生命的胶状物质构成的小型粉色魔物。
模样可爱，靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、苹果、空瓶、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
2. Lunatic
Plump and shaggy monster shaped in
a Rabbit. However it won't give you a
'Bunny Band'.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000:
Clover, Feather, Carrot, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
2. 疯兔
圆滚滚、毛茸茸的兔子形魔物。
不过，它可不会掉落“兔耳发圈”。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：
三叶草、羽毛、胡萝卜、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
3. Fabre
The weak and small larva of Creamy.
Although some say it is cute, the
author must disagree.
Whole-heartedly.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fluff, Feather, Green
Herb, Clover
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
3. 绿棉虫
克瑞米的幼虫，体型小，实力也弱。
虽然有人说它可爱，本书作者却绝不认同。
打心底里不认同。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：绒毛、羽毛、绿色药草、三叶草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
4. Creamy
A flying monster with beautiful
wings. It will escape by
teleporting if it thinks that it's
in grave danger.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Powder of Butterfly
Honey, Butterfly Wing, Flower
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
4. 克瑞米
长着美丽翅膀的飞行魔物。
一旦觉得自己身处险境，就会用瞬间移动逃跑。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝴蝶粉、蜂蜜、蝴蝶翅膀、花朵

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
5. Pupa
Monster that is the pupal stage of
Fabre. It doesn't attack at all, so
it's easy to kill for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
5. 虫蛹
绿棉虫进入蛹期后的形态。
完全不会攻击，初心者也能轻松击败它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
6. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Posion property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
6. 波波利
浅绿色、毒属性的波利，比波利强得多，却仍然靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
7. Rocker
A lazy grasshopper that loves to
play the violin, just like in
Aesop's fable.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Grasshopper's Leg,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
7. 蝗虫
懒洋洋的蝗虫，喜欢拉小提琴，就像伊索寓言里那只一样。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝗虫后腿、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
8. Bigfoot
Althought its name may be
misleading, Bigfoot is actually a
large bear. It walks like it owns
the forest, and it does.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bear's Foot Skin,
Animal Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
8. 大脚熊
名字虽容易让人误会，大脚熊其实是一头大熊。
它走起路来就像整片森林都归它管，而事实也确实如此。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：熊掌皮、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
9. Smokie
A chubby little raccoon that loves
nothing better than to scamper.
It's rumoured to use a magic leaf to
become invisible!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Raccoon Leaf, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
9. 狸猫
胖乎乎的小狸猫，最爱四处蹿来蹿去。
据说还会用魔法叶子隐身！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：变身叶子、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
10. Snake
Green Coloured Snake living in the
Forest or Desert. Not poisonous but
be careful.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snake Scale, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
10. 蛇
生活在森林或沙漠中的绿色蛇。
虽然无毒，还是要小心。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛇鳞、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
11. Wolf
Wild, roving wolves with blue
manes. They tend to attack as a
pack when even one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Wolf Claw, Meat,
Monster's Feed, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
11. 狼
长着蓝色鬃毛、四处游荡的野狼。
只要有一只受到威胁，整群往往就会一拥而上。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：狼指甲、肉、魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
12. Agriope
A segmented, millipede type monster
that will attack passerby with
poison.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bug Leg, Zargon, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
12. 蜈蚣
身体分节的多足类魔物，会用毒攻击路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫后脚、刹勒空结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
13. Agros
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
13. 蜘蛛
巨大的蜘蛛魔物，一见冒险者就会攻击。
个头太大，可不是抬脚就能踩扁的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
14. Chonchon
Fly monsters that move with great
speed. Amazingly, they can heal in
the presense of fecal matter.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Fly
Wing
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
14. 苍蝇
飞得极快的苍蝇魔物。
令人惊讶的是，只要有粪便在附近，它们就能恢复生命。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外壳、杰勒比结晶、苍蝇翅膀

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
15. Horn
Although it looks fierce, it's
actually a peaceful insect. It
roams around fields with a
crunching sound.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horn, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
15. 锹形虫
看着凶猛，其实是性情温和的昆虫。
在田野间游荡时，会发出咔嚓咔嚓的声响。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锹形虫角、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
16. Hunter Fly
Winged insects covered in the blood
of innocents. It's incredibly
quick, as well as strong. Novices
must flee from this monster at all
cost.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Solid Shell, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
16. 赤苍蝇
浑身沾满无辜者鲜血的飞虫，速度快得惊人，实力也很强。
初心者遇到它，无论如何都要逃走。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外皮、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
17. Mantis
It wanders about fields, waving a
tiny fan. An entire martial arts
style is based on the movements of
this insect.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mantis Scythe, Scell,
Solid Shell, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
17. 螳螂
挥着一把小扇子，在田野间游荡。
有一整套武术，就是从这种昆虫的动作中得到的灵感。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：螳螂臂、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
18. Stainer
Tiny little insect with a splendid,
ladybug-like shell. It can sense
magic and will attack once a spell
begins casting.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rainbow Shell, Garlet,
Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
18. 瓢虫
小小的昆虫，长着瓢虫般华丽的甲壳。
能感知魔法，一察觉有人开始施法，就会发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：彩色昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
19. Side Winder
A dark coloured snake that hates
people. Be careful, and kill them
before they can poison you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shining Scale, Zargon,
Poisonous Canine, Snake Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
19. 黑蛇
颜色暗沉、憎恨人类的蛇。
小心，最好在它下毒之前就把它解决掉。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：发亮鳞片、刹勒空结晶、毒牙、蛇鳞

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
20. Yoyo
Pink coloured Monkey. Not only do
they pick up everything dropped on the
ground, outrageously, but they are
nimble and cooperative, you must be
cautious of being attacked by a
group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yoyo Tail, Banana, Yellow
Herb, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
20. 溜溜猴
粉红色的猴子，肆无忌惮地捡走地上的一切。
它们身手敏捷，还会互相配合，要小心遭到围攻。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：溜溜猴尾巴、香蕉、黄色药草、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
21. Caramel
An adorable porcupine with tiny
spiky quills. However, it gets
incredibly angry when touched.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Porcupine Quill,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
21. 刺猬虫
长着细小尖刺的可爱豪猪。
不过，碰它一下，它就会大发雷霆。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：刺猬尖刺、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
22. Steel Chonchon
Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow
and green. It picks up everything
from the ground, so be careful not
to drop items.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Garlet, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
22. 绿苍蝇
与苍蝇相似，但全身呈黄绿色。
地上有什么就捡什么，千万别随便丢下物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
23. Coco
A small Squirrel with dark,
piercing eyes. It's always holding
an Acorn, and would be cute if it
didn't always have a look of utter
contempt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Acorn, Fluff, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
23. 松鼠
小松鼠，眼睛乌黑，目光锐利，总是抱着一颗橡果。
要不是整天摆出一副不屑的表情，倒也挺可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：橡果、绒毛、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
24. Dustiness
This flying monster has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
24. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物的回避率很高。
攻击命中率低的话，最好别去招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
25. Martin
An adorable mole wearing a safety
helmet. He's deathly afraid of
cave-ins and occasionally stops to
cower in fear.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mole Whiskers, Mole
Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
25. 土拨鼠
戴着安全帽的可爱土拨鼠。
它怕极了塌方，有时会停下来，吓得缩成一团。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠须、鼠指甲

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
26. Savage
A wild boar that walks around,
grunting restlessly. It's rough
looking tusks make it hard to
believe it was cute as a baby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mane, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫1楼魔物]^000000
26. 野猪
四处走动、焦躁地哼哼叫的野猪。
看着那凶悍的獠牙，实在难以相信它小时候也曾很可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鬃毛、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000

of a living gelatinous substance.
They're cute, and move by
bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,

scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
4. 克瑞米
长着美丽翅膀的飞行魔物。
一旦觉得自己身处险境，就会用瞬间移动逃跑。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝴蝶粉、蜂蜜、蝴蝶翅膀、花朵

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
5. Pupa
Monster that is the pupal stage of
Fabre. It doesn't attack at all, so
it's easy to kill for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
5. 虫蛹
绿棉虫进入蛹期后的形态。
完全不会攻击，初心者也能轻松击败它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
6. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Posion property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
6. 波波利
浅绿色、毒属性的波利，比波利强得多，却仍然靠弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
7. Rocker
A lazy grasshopper that loves to
play the violin, just like in
Aesop's fable.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Grasshopper's Leg,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
7. 蝗虫
懒洋洋的蝗虫，喜欢拉小提琴，就像伊索寓言里那只一样。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝗虫后腿、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
8. Bigfoot
Althought its name may be
misleading, Bigfoot is actually a
large bear. It walks like it owns
the forest, and it does.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bear's Foot Skin,
Animal Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
8. 大脚熊
名字虽容易让人误会，大脚熊其实是一头大熊。
它走起路来就像整片森林都归它管，而事实也确实如此。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：熊掌皮、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
9. Smokie
A chubby little raccoon that loves
nothing better than to scamper.
It's rumoured to use a magic leaf to
become invisible!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Raccoon Leaf, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
9. 狸猫
胖乎乎的小狸猫，最爱四处蹿来蹿去。
据说还会用魔法叶子隐身！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：变身叶子、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
10. Snake
Green Coloured Snake living in the
Forest or Desert. Not poisonous but
be careful.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snake Scale, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
10. 蛇
生活在森林或沙漠中的绿色蛇。
虽然无毒，还是要小心。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛇鳞、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
11. Wolf.
Wild, roving wolves with blue
manes. They tend to attack as a
pack when even one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Wolf Claw, Meat,
Monster's Feed, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
11. 狼
长着蓝色鬃毛、四处游荡的野狼。
只要有一只受到威胁，整群往往就会一拥而上。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：狼指甲、肉、魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
12. Agriope
A segmented, millipede type monster
that will attack passerby with
poison.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bug Leg, Zargon, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
12. 蜈蚣
身体分节的多足类魔物，会用毒攻击路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫后脚、刹勒空结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
13. Agros
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
13. 蜘蛛
巨大的蜘蛛魔物，一见冒险者就会攻击。
个头太大，可不是抬脚就能踩扁的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
14. Horn
Although it looks fierce, it's
actually a peaceful insect. It
roams around fields with a
crunching sound.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horn, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
14. 锹形虫
看着凶猛，其实是性情温和的昆虫。
在田野间游荡时，会发出咔嚓咔嚓的声响。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锹形虫角、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
15. Hunter Fly
Winged insects covered in the blood
of innocents. It's incredibly
quick, as well as strong. Novices
must flee from this monster at all
cost.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Solid Shell, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
15. 赤苍蝇
浑身沾满无辜者鲜血的飞虫，速度快得惊人，实力也很强。
初心者遇到它，无论如何都要逃走。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外皮、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
16. Mantis
It wanders about fields, waving a
tiny fan. An entire martial arts
style is based on the movements of
this insect.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mantis Scythe, Scell,
Solid Shell, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
16. 螳螂
挥着一把小扇子，在田野间游荡。
有一整套武术，就是从这种昆虫的动作中得到的灵感。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：螳螂臂、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
17. Stainer
Tiny little insect with a splendid,
ladybug-like shell. It can sense
magic and will attack once a spell
begins casting.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rainbow Shell, Garlet,
Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
17. 瓢虫
小小的昆虫，长着瓢虫般华丽的甲壳。
能感知魔法，一察觉有人开始施法，就会发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：彩色昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
18. Side Winder
A dark coloured snake that hates
people. Be careful, and kill them
before they can poison you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shining Scale, Zargon,
Poisonous Canine, Snake Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
18. 黑蛇
颜色暗沉、憎恨人类的蛇。
小心，最好在它下毒之前就把它解决掉。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：发亮鳞片、刹勒空结晶、毒牙、蛇鳞

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
19. Yoyo
Pink coloured Monkey. Not only do
they pick up everything dropped on the
ground, outrageously, but they are
nimble and cooperative, you must be
cautious of being attacked by a
group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yoyo Tail, Banana, Yellow
Herb, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
19. 溜溜猴
粉红色的猴子，肆无忌惮地捡走地上的一切。
它们身手敏捷，还会互相配合，要小心遭到围攻。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：溜溜猴尾巴、香蕉、黄色药草、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
20. Caramel
An adorable porcupine with tiny
spiky quills. However, it gets
incredibly angry when touched.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Porcupine Quill,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
20. 刺猬虫
长着细小尖刺的可爱豪猪。
不过，碰它一下，它就会大发雷霆。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：刺猬尖刺、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
21. Steel Chonchon
Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow
and green. It picks up everything
from the ground, so be careful not
to drop items.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Garlet, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
21. 绿苍蝇
与苍蝇相似，但全身呈黄绿色。
地上有什么就捡什么，千万别随便丢下物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：加勒结晶、坚硬外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
22. Coco
A small Squirrel with dark,
piercing eyes. It's always holding
an Acorn, and would be cute if it
didn't always have a look of utter
contempt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Acorn, Fluff, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
22. 松鼠
小松鼠，眼睛乌黑，目光锐利，总是抱着一颗橡果。
要不是整天摆出一副不屑的表情，倒也挺可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：橡果、绒毛、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
23. Dustiness
This flying monster has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
23. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物的回避率很高。
攻击命中率低的话，最好别去招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
24. Martin
An adorable mole wearing a safety
helmet. He's deathly afraid of
cave-ins and occasionally stops to
cower in fear.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mole Whiskers, Mole
Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
24. 土拨鼠
戴着安全帽的可爱土拨鼠。
它怕极了塌方，有时会停下来，吓得缩成一团。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠须、鼠指甲

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
25. Savage
A wild boar that walks around,
grunting restlessly. It's rough
looking tusks make it hard to
believe it was cute as a baby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mane, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
25. 野猪
四处走动、焦躁地哼哼叫的野猪。
看着那凶悍的獠牙，实在难以相信它小时候也曾很可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鬃毛、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
26. Savage Bebe
Tiny, pink baby Savage. It's
disheartening to know that it grows
up to become ugly-looking.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Animal Skin, Meat,
Arrow, Feather
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
26. 小野猪
小小的粉色野猪宝宝。
想到它长大后会变得那么丑，真让人沮丧。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：动物外皮、肉、箭矢、羽毛

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
27. Mastering
A giant Poring rarely seen in the
Morocc Desert, Mt. Mjolnir or the
Prontera Maze. It may be the Master
of Porings, but... it's still a
Poring
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Apple, Apple Juice
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
27. 波利之王
巨大的波利，在梦罗克沙漠、妙勒尼尔山或普隆德拉迷宫中偶尔能见到。
它或许是所有波利的首领，可...终究还是一只波利。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：苹果、苹果汁

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
28. Eclipse
Lord and Master of all Lunatics.
Its attacks may be weak, but it
has considerable defense.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Carrot, Glass Bead,
Milk, Carrot Juice
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
28. 可爱小玉兔
所有疯兔的首领。
攻击力虽然不强，防御力却相当可观。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：胡萝卜、玻璃珠、牛奶、红萝卜汁

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
29. Baphomet
A horned goat-like beast that
wields an intimidating scythe with
incredible might. Sired countless
Baphomet Jrs.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Evil Horn,
Yggdrasilberry, Animal Skin,
Oridecon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫3楼魔物]^000000
29. 巴风特
长着角的山羊形野兽，力大无穷，挥舞着令人胆寒的镰刀。
无数小巴风特都是它的子嗣。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：邪恶之角、天地树果实、动物外皮、神之金属

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
So you want to open your own shop
so that you can sell items to other
players and make zeny?
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
想开一家自己的商店，把物品卖给其他玩家，赚取Zeny吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do!
scripts.translation: 没错

scripts.text: Close the book.
scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
First, only certain job classes can
open vending shops. As a Merchant,
Blacksmith or Alchemist, you must
first learn ^009933Level 5 Enlarge Weight^000000
^009933Limit^000000, and then learn the ^009933Pushcart^000000
skill.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
首先，只有特定职业才能开设露天商店。
商人、铁匠或炼金术士必须先学会^0099335级负重量^000000^009933上升^000000，再学习^009933手推车使用^000000技能。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you have learned the Pushcart
skill, you can go ahead and rent a
Cart form a Kafra Employee. Once
this cart is equipped, it won't
disappear as long as you don't take
it off.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
学会手推车使用后，就能向卡普拉职员租用手推车。
装备后，只要不卸下，手推车就不会消失。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
However, equipping a Cart reduces
your movement speed. You can
recover this movement speed by
continuing to add skill points to
the ^009933Pushcart^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
不过，装备手推车会降低移动速度。
继续提升^009933手推车使用^000000技能的等级，就能逐步恢复移动速度。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now, this next part is very
important. If you want to be able
to sell what is inside your cart,
you must learn ^009933Level 3 Pushcart^000000 so
that youc an learn ^009933Vending^000000,
allowing you to sell items inside
your cart.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
接下来这点非常重要。
想出售手推车里的物品，就得先学会^0099333级手推车使用^000000，才能学习^009933露天商店^000000技能。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Remember, only items inside your
Cart can be sold with the Vending
skill. Press the '^009933Alt^000000' and ^009933W^000000' keys
to open the Cart Window labeled
'Rent a Cart Item.'
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
记住，露天商店技能只能出售手推车里的物品。
按下“^009933Alt^000000”和“^009933W^000000”键，就能打开名为“租用手推车物品”的手推车窗口。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
You can drag and drop items from
your Inventory Window into this
Cart Window. You can also click the
'^009933items^000000' button int he Equipment
Window (^009933Alt^000000 + ^009933Q^000000) to open the Cart
Window.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
可以将物品从物品栏拖进手推车窗口。
也可以在装备窗口中点击“^009933物品^000000”按钮，打开手推车窗口；装备窗口的快捷键是^009933Alt^000000 + ^009933Q^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now use the Vending skill. Two
windows will pop up. ^009933Available^000000
^009933 items for Vending^000000 and ^009933 Vend a Shop^000000.

^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Drag and drop items from the
^009933Available items for Vending^000000
Window into the ^009933Vend a Shop^000000 Window.
Then, in the ^009933Vend a Shop^000000 window,
you may set prices and name your
shop.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
将物品从^009933可出售物品^000000窗口拖进^009933开设商店^000000窗口。
然后，在^009933开设商店^000000窗口里设置价格，并为商店起个名字。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
After confirming the items and
prices, click the 'OK' button. The
^009933My Shop^000000 window will appear.
Congratulations, you are now
vending your items!
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
确认物品和价格后，点击“确定”按钮，就会出现^009933我的商店^000000窗口。
恭喜，现在你已经开始摆摊了！

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you close the ^009933My Shop^000000 window,
your shop will be closed. You can
check the prices of your items in
the ^009933My Shop^000000 window, and your sales
will be recorded in the chat
window.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
关闭^009933我的商店^000000窗口，商店也会随之关闭。
在^009933我的商店^000000窗口里可以查看物品价格，销售记录则会显示在聊天窗口中。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When everything's sold out, the
shop will automatically close.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
所有物品售罄后，商店会自动关闭。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
SuperNovices can learn all the
skills needed to open vending
shops, but none of the Kafra
Employees will rent Carts to them.
If only they could find somewhere
to rent a cart...
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
超级初心者能学会开设露天商店所需的所有技能，可卡普拉职员却不肯租给他们手推车。
要是能找到个地方租手推车就好了...

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Blacksmith Guide for Dummies]^000000
This is a useful guide detailing
the process of Ore Refining and
Weapon Crafting for Blacksmith job
class characters.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[铁匠新手指南]^000000
这本实用指南详细介绍了铁匠提炼矿石和制作武器的流程。

scripts.text: Ore Refining.

scripts.text: Weapon Craft
